text: あら　つよそうな　ポケモン　うって　くれるの？

structure.jp: つよそうな　ポケモン

structure.en: will you sell them to me?

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form verb says someone does the thing for the speaker. うって　くれる = 'sell (them) to me'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そう replacing the last い of a describing word means 'looks like it is'. つよそうな　ポケモン = 'strong-looking Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a soft, casual question. うって　くれるの？ = 'are you going to sell them to me?'
